text: Global warming is caused mostly by human activities.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: Yale/GMU Climate Change in the American Mind, Spring 2026
room.questionWording: Assuming global warming is happening, do you think it is caused mostly by human activities, mostly by natural changes in the environment, other, or none of the above because global warming isn’t happening?
room.note: 27% said mostly natural changes; the remaining 14% said other, neither, or don’t know.

truthSource.label: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report
truthSource.oneLine: The IPCC concludes it is unequivocal that human influence has warmed the atmosphere, ocean and land.
